notes.title: [commentary] How to Play "Pricolage -IDOLIZED-"!
notes.notes:
In this article, we will introduce how to play "Pricolage -IDOLIZED-".
There will be some tips at the end in case you get stuck, so please be sure to read through it all!



[h2]How to Play - Basics
[/h2]
[h3]Click on the area of interest.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423607/d8cc2afa27a2746edd4444be8d1b2804d2085cca.png[/img]
Click on the part you are interested in.


[h3]Search On the Search Bar[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423607/6f541a2d862229ce5b5481eec100f292a1c966be.png[/img]
Click on the search bar at the top of the screen to click and search from the terms you acquired.


[h3]Fill the Todo list[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423607/565d1eec93247520fb99b8b0d057f461b886af51.png[/img]
When you search for a search word you have acquired, a check will be placed on the Todo list. When the entire task list is checked, the next task list is released.


[h3]Send messages to suspicious people.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423607/99d70291b3eb1066c7c1535cf0dc70a6c62c6068.png[/img]
Sometimes you can DM the accounts you are interested in to gather information.


[h3]Collect evidence[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423607/6eff141f97fb9d7ac8af5f72cfc7b1f5ddfd1c60.png[/img]
There is also an exploratory part where you collect evidence by screenshots. Click to collect screenshots.


[h2]Tips.[/h2]
If you're stuck...
[list]
[*] Try guessing from the names of items on the Todo list.
[*] Look at the posts in the hashtag.
[*] Look for accounts you can jump to from comments.
[*] Read the contents of DM messages carefully.
[/list]
We highly recommend these actions!


[h2]Finally…[/h2]
How was your experience? If this article has piqued your interest in Pricolage -IDOLIZED- t, we hope you will give it a try! We hope that the contents of this article will make your internet stalking life more comfortable.

notes.title: Game Streaming Guideline
notes.notes:
Video Posting and Live Streaming
We permit the posting of videos and live streaming that include introductions, play-throughs, and commentary using game footage, for both individuals and corporations, and for both profit and non-profit purposes.

When posting or streaming, please include the following in the description:

Store page URL
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2510890/_IDOLIZED/
A message regarding spoilers (example below)
"Please try playing the game yourself before watching the stream all the way through if you want to enjoy the gameplay on your own!"
We ask that you include these two points!
